messages:
alex: anyone else see main go red right after my merge? merged PR #3412 about 12:03 UTC
ci-bot: CI ALERT: pipeline 'main' failed on step 'gpu-smoke' (build 54872) — failing test: tests/inference/test_kv_cache.py::test_kv_cache_persistence 
ci-bot: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/54872
sasha: pinging @eng-infra — who owns the gpu-smoke job? :eyes:
dan: alex, can you paste the merge SHA? need to scope the range for bisect if necessary
alex: sha=ac9f12e (merged to main). I ran unit + cpu smoke locally but skipped gpu matrix in the PR job
maya: i'm online, i'll take a look. @ci-bot can you dump the failing tail logs and artifact path?
ci-bot: artifacts: /artifacts/54872/gpu-smoke/
ci-bot: failing log (tail):
```
E           TimeoutError: KV restore timed out after 30.01s
.../tests/inference/test_kv_cache.py:87: TimeoutError
```
jessica: that timeout smells like a scheduling/slot contention flake on certain GPU shapes. might be intermittent. @maya can you rerun the matrix with KERNEL_DEBUG=1 and a single shard?
maya: rerun kicked off: /ci rerun 54872 --matrix gpu-smoke --env KERNEL_DEBUG=1 --shards 1 (new build 54873) :thumbsup:
ci-bot: build 54873 triggered by maya — monitor: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/54873
ci-bot: build 54873 completed — RESULT: FAIL — same test failed 2/3 runs, failing on p3-large only
jessica: okay can someone run a bisect across commits between ac9f12e~5..ac9f12e? i'll help analyze. Command we used: /ci bisect --range ac9f12e~5..ac9f12e --test tests/inference/test_kv_cache.py::test_kv_cache_persistence
dan: running bisect now, will post first bad commit when found
dan: bisect result: first bad commit identified -> 1c3d9b2 (change: reorder kv flush to improve throughput)
alex: that's in my PR — i swapped flush order to reduce stalls. didn't expect timing to break the restore path. i'll open a revert PR now
alex: revert submitted: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/3478 (revert 1c3d9b2)
ci-bot: revert merged to main; new pipeline triggered (build 54874)
ci-bot: build 54874 completed — RESULT: PASS — all smoke jobs green
maya: green across matrix now, marking the test as flaky and creating follow-up to add a deterministic repro and a stress harness :white_check_mark:
jessica: created issue #1892: "kv_cache restore flake on certain GPU shapes" — assigning to runtime team and linking revert PR
alex: thanks everyone — sorry for the late-night noise, will follow up in the issue with a proper fix and perf regression notes
sasha: thanks for the quick turnaround :clap:
_extra_note: This doc is synthetic and follows the slack thread schema: single string of messages, prefixed by sender names. No title field included.
